version.changelog: Fix the enhancement silently reverting to the stock list while the page stays open: only the rendered picker instance is enhanced now (a hidden sibling could previously steal it), the stylesheet self-heals and a 1s heartbeat recovers any silent loss, and the official search filter no longer drops the two-column layout.

llm.summary: The skill mostly does what it says, but it under-discloses an injected browser update checker that periodically makes authenticated same-origin requests and can reload the UI automatically.

dimensions.detail: The browser script polls './' after 30 seconds and every 5 minutes with credentials:'same-origin' and may call location.reload(), while SKILL.md, README.md, and 说明.md also claim no network access or no network requests.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses PowerShell with ExecutionPolicy Bypass and modifies the OpenClaw package's control-ui index.html/assets directory; the script is scoped, backs up index.html, supports -Remove, and does not fetch remote code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording is broad enough for normal OpenClaw model-picker repair or install requests to lead to local patching, but the described requests are still within the skill's stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The patch persists as a script tag and copied asset until uninstall or OpenClaw upgrade; the artifact does not include the optional scheduled watchdog, services, startup hooks, or cross-session agent memory changes.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, a two-column OpenClaw Control UI model picker, matches the included installer and browser script; local index.html injection, asset copying, and hiding the account row are directly tied to that UI enhancement.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if your OpenClaw Control UI is authenticated or contains sensitive work. The local file patch is scoped and reversible, but the injected browser script will periodically request the current app origin with browser-managed same-origin credentials and may reload the page when it detects an update; install only if that behavior is acceptable.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The invocation examples and description can route install/repair requests to a local UI patcher, but the artifact does state that it installs, repairs, verifies, or uninstalls a browser-side enhancement injected into index.html; this supports user caution rather than a malicious verdict.
[T09] unexpected: The same-origin update polling and automatic reload are partly described as self-updating behavior, but the explicit 'no network access'/'no network requests' safety claims are contradicted by fetch('./', {cache:'no-store', credentials:'same-origin'}), making the disclosure materially incomplete.
